thread:
maria: OK team — finalizing webinar topic and run order. Narrowed to three practical angles, need quick votes and speaker confirmations. TL;DR: want a 45min live + 15min Q&A, one demo, one benchmark slide, one customer case.

maria: Options: 1) "Cost-first inference: how to hit 10x cheaper tokens without sacrificing UX" 2) "Predictable latency at scale: fallbacks, routing, and SLA patterns" 3) "From prototype to SLA: deploying open models in regulated apps" — pick 1.

tom: +1 option 1. resonates w/ inbound CRM.

sheila: leaning 2 for enterprise audience, but 1 gets better PR/bench soundbites.

rahul: if we pick 1 I can land a benchmarking slide (latency vs cost tradeoff) and show batching numbers.

maria: ok leaning 1. speaker asks: @tom can you do the cost narrative + demo? @sheila can you handle enterprise fallback slide as backup?

tom: yes I can do demo — will need a 10-12min slot and a pre-recorded fallback clip in case live demo dies.

sheila: happy to own fallback slide + 5min callout. Also can cover routing policies quickly.

maria: rehearsal cadence — want 2 rehearsals: dry run (full run) 3 days before, micro-run 1 day before. suggested slots: Wed 9am PT (dry), Fri 11am PT (micro).

rahul: both ok for infra. will prep a short checklist: model pin, quantized variant, canary rule, metric hooks.

maria: run-of-show draft (45min + 15 Q&A):
```
0:00–0:03 Welcome + housekeeping (maria)
0:03–0:12 Why cost matters — high level narrative (tom)
0:12–0:22 Live demo: low-cost pipeline + batching (tom)
0:22–0:28 Benchmark slide: cost/latency breakdown (rahul)
0:28–0:34 Enterprise fallbacks & SLA patterns (sheila)
0:34–0:40 Customer mini-case (pre-recorded) / quick takeaway (maria)
0:40–0:45 Closing CTA + resources (maria)
0:45–1:00 Live Q&A (panel)
```

maria: quick asks: (a) tom — confirm demo infra + 5 test prompts by EOD Tue, (b) rahul — produce benchmark CSV & chart by Wed noon, (c) sheila — draft fallback slide by Wed noon, (d) marketing — short landing page copy + CTAs by Thu.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Webinar — Cost-first inference" — Wed 2026-04-08 16:00 UTC (Dry run) and Fri 2026-04-10 18:00 UTC (Micro).

tom: will share demo checklist in thread tomorrow.

sheila: adding talking points to slide deck now.

maria: sweet. if no objections by EOD today we'll lock topic and ship invites tomorrow. :rocket:
